command:
for f in /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/compatible /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/chosen/bootargs /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/chosen/stdout-path; do printf "
%s
" "$f"; tr "\000" "
" < "$f"; done; cat /proc/cmdline
lsblk -o NAME,MAJ:MIN,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,LABEL,UUID,MOUNTPOINT; cat /proc/partitions; cat /proc/mtd; cat /proc/mounts; df -h; fdisk -l /dev/mmcblk1
command -v xmutil xlnx-bootfw xlnx_platformstats xbutil xdputil xclbinutil dtc python3 rpm opkg dnf lsusb v4l2-ctl media-ctl arecord aplay i2cdetect; cat /usr/bin/xmutil; head -n 100 /usr/bin/xdputil
